summary: The marketing team is juggling multiple high-priority initiatives including the China Going-Global report, Asia Start and Intelligent China program promotions, and key event sponsorships, with urgent action needed this week on SEO strategy, website redesign feedback, and event coordination.
summaryDetail: The most pressing focus is the China Going-Global report, with Joseph reviewing the full compiled version by August 5 and providing notes, while also summarizing the Manaferra engagement. Simultaneously, SEO and program promotion for Asia Start and Intelligent China are being prioritized, with Joseph drafting target areas and prompts, and the team analyzing existing participants and CRM leads to build audience profiles. The knowledge website redesign is also active, with feedback due on Joseph's editorial-style design to integrate more articles and indices, and the removal of the videos panel. On the events front, CKGSB is sponsoring Tech In Asia Conference in Singapore (Sept 15-16) and co-hosting an EV event with EuroCham, with several action items due this week including booking Prof. Li Wei, revising PO content, and confirming SBA case sharing. Additionally, the social media agency selection is being expedited, with a decision leaning towards Media Minds, and procurement is being notified. Urgent this week: finalize SEO drafts, provide website redesign feedback, and complete event-related confirmations to keep these initiatives on track.
